svg.title: What sim.launch.py starts
svg.desc: Deployment view of one simulation: processes and component containers, their namespaces and nodes, which part is simulated, and which exits stop the whole launch.

g.text: Every node gets the same merged parameter dict; the launcher adds is_simulation = true, installation_id = 9998, use_sim_time = true (false only for sim/clock).

text.font-family: 'IBM Plex Sans', 'Segoe UI', Roboto, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

g.text: Not started in simulation: the agvhito proxy_node that talks to the real AGVs, and the bay and VECS hardware drivers.

g.text: Three component containers and a handful of processes, all in ROS domain 75 unless ROS_DOMAIN_ID is set. The scheduler runs inside the central container, as on site. If

text.font-family: 'IBM Plex Sans', 'Segoe UI', Roboto, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

g.text: the clock process or the sim_nodes container exits unexpectedly, the launch shuts down.
